summary: Learn low-code workflow design, approvals, controls, and KPI reporting. Build practical automation outputs in this hands-on course. Enrol today.
lede: Business process automation for administrative and operations teams helps replace email chasing, duplicate data entry, unclear approvals, and memory-dependent exception handling with visible, measurable workflows. The course uses BPMN 2.0, SIPOC analysis, control-point design, and low-code tools to identify, redesign, and improve high-friction processes. You will practise assessing automation potential, mapping current workflows, assigning RACI accountability, configuring controlled approvals in Microsoft Power Automate, and creating performance views in Power BI. You will also develop exception routes, control-point checklists, test scripts, and an implementation roadmap while exploring API integration, robotic process automation, and AI-assisted process analysis at an overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who own, improve, approve, or support recurring office and operational workflows. It suits mixed technical and non-technical teams seeking practical business process automation skills without a programming prerequisite.
prerequisites: You need access to a laptop for guided workflow design and dashboard exercises. Familiarity with email, spreadsheets, shared documents, and your organization’s approval procedures will help you contribute effectively. The course uses illustrative process data and does not require access to production systems. Advanced concepts such as API integration, robotic process automation, and AI-assisted analysis are covered at conceptual awareness level, while BPMN mapping, workflow design, testing, and measurement receive operational application practice.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
